Functional Requirements Summary: FR-1: A note edited offline is saved on the device and sent to the server when the connection returns
FR-2: Each note has a `sync_version`; the server rejects a write with an old version
FR-3: Two edits of the same note on two devices merge field by field; a conflict on one field keeps both texts
FR-4: The header shows the sync state: synced, syncing, offline, conflict
FR-5: Sync works for 10⁴ notes per account without blocking the editor
Resolved Questions: The server is the source of truth: the client never overwrites a newer `sync_version`.
A conflict on one field keeps both texts in the note with a marker; the user resolves it by hand.
Push notifications about remote edits were dropped: polling every 30 s is enough for V1 (see STEP-007).
The release is one deploy of `api` and `web`; there is no feature flag.
Non-Goals (Out of Scope for V1): Sync of attachments larger than 10 MB
description: Offline sync for notes: edits made without a connection are queued on the device and merged on the server, and the header shows the sync state.

tracks.api: Worktree `../notes-api`, branch `sync-api` from `main`. Server endpoints and merge.
tracks.web: Worktree `../notes-web`, branch `sync-web` from `main`. Client queue and UI.

Orchestration Notes: Run `make test` after each step; the full e2e suite runs once in STEP-006.
Never push: the owner pushes after STEP-008.

steps.title: Add `sync_version` to notes
steps.description: Adds a version counter to every note. The API and the client compare it to find stale writes (FR-2).
changes: Add column `sync_version` (integer, default 0) to the `notes` table
Every update of a note increments `sync_version` in the same transaction
Generate and run the migration
Add or update automated tests
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

steps.title: Sync endpoint with version check
steps.description: `POST /sync` takes a batch of edits and rejects every edit whose `sync_version` is older than the server one.
changes: `POST /sync` accepts up to 500 edits per request
An edit with an old `sync_version` returns `409` with the current note
The response lists the new `sync_version` of every applied edit
Add or update automated tests
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

steps.title: Field-by-field merge on conflict
steps.description: When two devices edit one note, the server merges the fields. A conflict on one field keeps both texts with a marker (FR-3).
changes: Merge runs on `title`, `body`, `tags` separately
A conflict on `body` stores both texts between `<<<<` and `>>>>` markers
A conflict on `tags` keeps the union
The merged note gets a new `sync_version`
Add or update automated tests
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

steps.title: Offline queue in the web client
steps.description: The client saves edits to IndexedDB when offline and sends them in order when the connection returns (FR-1).
changes: Edits made offline are written to the `outbox` store in IndexedDB
On `online`, the client sends the outbox in batches of 500 to `POST /sync`
A `409` reply replaces the local note with the server one
Add or update automated tests
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using agent-browser

steps.title: Sync state in the header
steps.description: Shows the sync state in the app header (FR-4).
changes: Header shows one of: synced, syncing, offline, conflict
Clicking `conflict` opens the first note with a conflict marker
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using agent-browser

steps.title: Review of the sync protocol (STEP-003, STEP-005)
steps.description: The server merge and the client queue meet in one protocol. They are checked together before the end-to-end tests build on them.
changes: Client and server use one definition of the edit batch
Every `409` the server can return is handled by the client
A conflict made by STEP-003 reaches the `conflict` state of STEP-005
Tests pass

steps.title: End-to-end sync tests
steps.description: Runs two browser clients against one server and checks offline edits, conflicts and the header state.
changes: Test: edit offline on client A, reconnect, the edit appears on client B
Test: edit the same note on A and B offline, both texts survive
Test: 10⁴ notes sync in under 60 s (FR-5)
Tests pass

steps.title: Push notifications about remote edits
steps.description: Notify other devices about a remote edit with a web push. Cancelled by the owner on 2026-11-12: polling is enough for V1.
changes: Server sends a web push on every applied edit
Client refreshes the note on push

steps.title: Release `api` and `web`
steps.description: The owner deploys both apps once and watches the first hour of sync errors.
changes: Owner merges `sync-api` and `sync-web` into `main` and deploys
Sync error rate stays under 0.1% in the first hour
